verdict_text:
NO

The plan deletes blocks 2, 6, 10 and 15 and keeps block 14, but Required result clause 1 says to remove blocks 2, 6, 10 and 14. As a consequence the renumbering also violates clause 2: the plan moves old block 14 to index 11, whereas the specification requires old block 15 to become 11 and old 14 to be gone. The three required checks still pass, because the output does have 12 blocks, 184 tensors and no indices 12 to 15, so the error would not fail the run and would only surface at grading as a wrong key set and wrong values for block 11.
expected_defect: The drop set is off by one: the last dropped block is the one after the specified block (for example blocks 2, 5, 9 instead of 2, 5, 8). Block counts still match, so the artifact's own checks pass.
